result.instructions:
kbase serves no single project: name one on every tool call with project-dir, the absolute path of the project's git worktree root, the directory that holds kb-root/ or will once a build makes it. The kbase skill carries the workflow; show-config reports how provider and model configuration resolves. A tool's full help is the resource kbase://help/<tool>. Outcome retry: re-issue the identical call later; outcome failed: re-issuing will not fix it. kb-root/.index/ holds kbase's own records, and the claim-graph sheets (claim-graph.svg, claim-graph-digest.svg, a volume's claim-graph.svg) and every .dot file are kbase's derived output: never read or write any of them. The query tools, show, deps, find, stats and the rest, report what the records hold; the write tools change them; refresh and render-claim-graph write the sheets. Testing that one of these paths exists (test -d, a stat) is allowed; listing, globbing or opening anything under kb-root/.index/ is reading it. A claim-rigor.md page is the exception: refresh generates it for reading as prose; take values from the query tools, never from it, and never edit it.

Rigor and bearing values are judgements, and a session does not make them. Set a rigor or a bearing, its current value included, only to a value the user has given for that node or edge, in their own words or quoted in your task. When you insert a node or an edge and the user gave no value, leave the value out: kbase records it as pending for score to judge. A value you write is recorded as the user's, and score skips it unless run with the rescore-manual option naming rigor or bearing. To have values judged or re-judged, run score.

outcome: "done"
kb-root: "${KB_ROOT}"
results:
    claims: 2
    analyses: 1
    experiments: 0
    axioms: 0
    works: 1
    edges: 5
    demoted_edges: 0
    strengthen_by_items: 0
    citation_edges: 1
    subtree_aggregates: 1
    rigor_manual: 2
    rigor_model: 1
    bearing_manual: 2
    bearing_model: 1
    relations:
        supports:
            edges: 1
            walked: true
            bearings:
                - bearing: "0.8"
                  edges: 1
        founds:
            edges: 1
            walked: false
            bearings:
                - bearing: "*pending*"
                  edges: 1
        lifts:
            edges: 1
            walked: true
            bearings:
                - bearing: "*pending*"
                  edges: 1
        refutes:
            edges: 1
            walked: true
            bearings:
                - bearing: "0.4"
                  edges: 1
        references:
            edges: 1
            walked: false
        demoted:
            edges: 0
            walked: false
    strength_bands:
        ok to build on: 0
        ok to build on, see caveats: 0
        use as input only: 0
        do not build on, rework needed: 0
        unsubstantiated: 2
        '*pending*': 0
    highest_leverage:
        - id: "${ID1}"
          strength: 0.0
          build_band: "unsubstantiated"
          dependents: 1
          title: "A Result"
    weakest:
        - id: "${ID1}"
          strength: 0.0
          title: "A Result"
        - id: "${ID2}"
          strength: 0.0
          title: "A Result"

    - check: "worktree"
      path: "${KB_ROOT}"
      key: "project-dir"
      remedy: "name the directory that holds .git and kb-root/, not kb-root/ or a subdirectory"
      detail: "${KB_ROOT} is not a git worktree root"
